contradictions.topic: Canh Tứ Hóa lineage conflict (Khoa / Kỵ cells)
contradictions.description: Secondary attributions for Zhongzhou/Wang Canh as 阳武府同 (Khoa=Thiên Phủ) conflict with other documented lineages (e.g. 阳武同阴 Khoa/Kỵ cells) and with Nam Phái released runtime (Canh Khoa=Thái Âm). Wang materials also caution 阳武府相. No primary edition locator is committed.
